audit_items.proof_trace: The sum invariant holds by construction: projectTransfer is computed as `T - legionFee - referrerFee`, so sum = (T-L-R) + L + R = T in all four cases (L=0/≠0, R=0/≠0). Integer-division truncation does not break the sum because truncated remainders remain in the project transfer amount. The `if (fee != 0)` guards only skip zero-value transfers, which are already captured in the project amount.
